mapper.sql: id, user_id, note_id, order_no, bucket, object_key, url, thumb_object_key, thumb_url, mime, size_bytes, width, height, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO media (user_id, note_id, order_no, bucket, object_key, url, mime, size_bytes, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{noteId}, #{orderNo}, #{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{url}, #{mime}, #{sizeBytes}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM media WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE media SET status = #{status}, thumb_object_key = #{thumbObjectKey}, thumb_url = #{thumbUrl}, width = #{width}, height = #{height} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM media WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND note_id IS NULL
